jp_verse:
ただ一本

    静けさだけが

    先に立つ
en_verse: one line remains\nbefore the world decides\nto multiply

jp_verse:
二つ置き

    あいだに生まれる

    やわらかな間
en_verse: not alone now\nspace starts speaking\nbetween equals

jp_verse:
三つ並び

    目にも心にも

    落ちついて
en_verse: the third mark lands\nand suddenly the air\nfeels arranged

jp_verse:
囲まれて

    静かに残る

    内の気配
en_verse: a frame appears\nand what was open\nlearns to stay

jp_verse:
まっすぐで

    まっすぐでない

    その強さ
en_verse: it almost balances\nbut keeps one hidden turn\nto stay alive

jp_verse:
上に息

    下へひらいて

    形になる
en_verse: from the top\nthe thought breaks open\ninto room

jp_verse:
ひとすじが

    少し曲がって

    意志になる
en_verse: one stroke turns\nand suddenly feels\nlike intent

jp_verse:
左右へと

    ひらいてゆけば

    道になる
en_verse: the middle opens\nand the world stops asking\nfor only one way

jp_verse:
曲がりつつ

    ほどけず残る

    強い先
en_verse: it leans forward\nwithout falling out\nof itself

jp_verse:
縦と横

    出会ったところに

    芯が立つ
en_verse: where lines cross\na quiet center\nholds them both

jp_verse:
声の前

    四角い静けさ

    口を待つ
en_verse: before the word\nthere is an opening\nwaiting to speak

jp_verse:
日の中に

    おさまる光

    まだあたたかい
en_verse: day stands still\ninside its simple walls\nglowing quietly

jp_verse:
月明かりが

    静かな水面を照らし

    夜を包んだ
en_verse: Moonlight softly shone\nacross the silent water,\nembracing the night.

jp_verse:
田の区切り

    育つためには

    道も要る
en_verse: the earth is split\nso life can rise\nwith somewhere to go

jp_verse:
見つめれば

    形の奥にも

    気配あり
en_verse: the eye holds still\nand more than the surface\ncomes forward

jp_verse:
古きもの

    消えずに残る

    声のよう
en_verse: old does not mean gone\nit means the shape of time\nstill speaking

jp_verse:
われここに

    大きく言わず

    ただ在りぬ
en_verse: I am not thunder\njust a place from which\nthe world is answered

jp_verse:
見えぬまま

    それでも一歩

    出してみる
en_verse: risk is not noise\nit is the quiet foot\nthat still goes on

jp_verse: 並び立つ\n似た灯どうしの\nあたたかさ
en_verse: side by side\nnot one shadow deeper\nthan the other

jp_verse:
日と月が

    ともにあるとき

    明るさ満つ
en_verse: brightness deepens\nwhen light meets another light\nand neither fades
